textual.observation: The source promotes OneCoin with exceptional income and growth claims while encouraging viewers to join its partner structure and participate in recommendation-based income.

evidence.quote: This project offers a unique bonus plan and it took only 12 months for 400 people to earn 35,000 euros a week.
Money for recommendation, it means for building the structure of people and money from the OneCoin itself where you can trade the currency in the internal exchange.
Enter our program now and join more than 650 000 partners

textual.context: Promotional presentation; the source describes both recommendation-based income and income from the currency. The records do not establish whether the claims are accurate.
textual.potential_relevance: Later review may assess the relationship between the promised weekly earnings, the request to join the program, and the recommendation-based structure.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual earnings, payments, losses, participation requirements, or whether the described structure operated as stated.

textual.observation: The source claims very large returns and rapid appreciation associated with OneCoin, including a reported monthly income exceeding one million dollars and a stated 2,400% value increase.

evidence.quote: With One Coin, he earns more than $1 million a
From January 1 to October 25, 2015, the value of one, 1 coin increased from 0.1 Euro to 2.5 Euro. That is more than 2,400% and the currency is still growing stronger.

textual.context: The claims are presented as promotional examples attributed to named individuals and to the currency's stated performance. The first quote is truncated at the end of the supplied record.
textual.potential_relevance: Later review may assess whether the exceptional income and appreciation claims are connected to the program's recruitment or participation offer.
textual.limitations: The supplied records do not verify the individuals' income, the valuation, the calculation, or the conditions under which any return could be obtained.

textual.observation: The source directs viewers to click an earnings button, submit their name and email, and register as a partner in exchange for video manuals and a wealth code.

evidence.quote: Click on the button under the video I WANT TO EARN MONEY You will be redirected to a form where you only need to fill in your name and email and we will send you the Video Manuals.
You will immediately become our partner and you will get your own wealth code.

textual.context: Direct promotional call to action; the records do not show the form, destination, or any additional data or payment requirements.
textual.potential_relevance: Later review may assess the relationship between the earnings-oriented call to action, collection of name and email, and immediate partner registration.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what happens after submission, whether the information is used, whether payment is required, or whether the promised materials or code are delivered.

visual.observation: An on-screen graphic states that during a 12-month period, "400 partners" earn "$35,000 per week."
visual.context: Promotional context is suggested by the branded presentation, but the sampled frame does not show a specific instruction or action for viewers.
visual.potential_relevance: The stated weekly earnings are explicitly associated with becoming or being one of a limited number of partners, creating a reward claim linked to participation or recruitment-related status.
visual.limitations: The frame does not show how to become a partner, whether payment or recruitment is required, whether the claim is typical or guaranteed, or whether the stated outcome occurred.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source presents the opportunity as free and uses urgent or strongly promotional language encouraging immediate participation.

evidence.quote: So do not hesitate and become a part of the revolution in currencies of this century — for free!

visual_context_notes.observation: The video visibly presents OneCoin-related branding, including a "WEALTH CODE" title, a digital-currency coin graphic, and a OneCoin-branded interview backdrop.

A Chinese subtitle describes Onecoin as an innovative cryptocurrency and compares it with Bitcoin; the sampled frame does not establish whether this is quotation, endorsement, reporting, or another context.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a rapidly growing currency and an opportunity for financial freedom, while presenting large earnings and growth claims to recruit viewers. It explicitly says income comes from building a structure of people and urges viewers to register as partners and join, tying recruitment to the promised earning opportunity.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video expressly links one income stream to building a people structure, supports that pitch with earnings claims, and directs viewers to become partners and join the program. The evidence does not establish a multi-level hierarchy or qualification tiers, so the classification rests on the stated recruitment-dependent structure rather than an inferred matrix.
